lines.text: Did you know? Spir is Latin for breathe.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus breathe?

words.ex: My work visa expires at the end of the year.
The designer found inspiration for the new collection in nature.
Smoke from the forest fires caused respiratory problems for many residents.

publish.title: Spir root: expire, inspiration and respiratory
publish.value: Spir comes from Latin "spirare" (to breathe). Words: expire, inspiration and respiratory. expire = ex + pire; inspiration = in + spir; respiratory = re + spir.
